# Instrumental variables regression: 2SLS, LIML and weak-instrument-robust inference

> Free instrumental variables (IV) regression tool. Upload a CSV with an outcome, one or more endogenous regressors, excluded instruments and exogenous controls, and get OLS, two-stage least squares, LIML and Fuller (a = 1) side by side with unadjusted, heteroskedasticity-robust or cluster-robust standard errors; first-stage R-squared, partial R-squared, Shea's partial R-squared, the first-stage F and the Montiel Olea-Pflueger effective F; Sargan and Hansen J tests of the overidentifying restrictions; Durbin, Wu-Hausman and control-function tests of exogeneity; and the Anderson-Rubin confidence set (one endogenous regressor), which stays valid when instruments are weak. Matches linearmodels 7.1 within 1e-11. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are statistical estimates from the data you supply, not legal, tax, financial, medical, policy or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/instrumental-variables/)

## Use it from code

- `node cli.mjs data.csv --outcome y --endogenous x --instruments z1,z2 --exogenous w1,w2 [--se unadjusted|robust|clustered] [--cluster id] [--estimator 2sls|liml|fuller] [--debiased] [--csv|--json]`
- `node cli.mjs --example` for 3,000 simulated people in 150 counties (true return to schooling 0.08; OLS 0.107, 2SLS 0.064 with clustered SE 0.023)
- `node platform/agents/tools.mjs call instrumental-variables analyze --input '{"csv":"...","outcome":"y","endogenous":"x","instruments":"z1,z2","exogenous":"w"}'`

## What it answers

- What does a regressor that people chose (schooling, price, dose, hours) do to the outcome, using instruments that move it and reach the outcome only through it?
- Are the instruments strong enough (first-stage F, effective F), and if not, what interval is still valid (Anderson-Rubin)?
- Do several instruments agree (Sargan, Hansen J), and is IV needed at all (Durbin, Wu-Hausman, control-function test)?
